book.name: ROME
book.title: MUKAANA A POOLE KUNDAA BASI ROME

content: Nyaã nswe mbwuru akala kunsa litumu li bamfumu ba baatkatumu. Mu kuulu, nswe litumu liikafa kundaa Nzaami, ya yini a Nzaami aakagwa nswe litumu.
Me mu obo, munde wu aakabihi litumu, nde aakatemene nsumu ya litumu li otwulu Nzaami. Babo ba baakatemene nsumu ya litumu li Nzaami sa babagha masyeme mu manyuru ma bo.
Mu kuulu, ba baakasa bubwe ka baakakala a nzalamweẽ a bamfumu o, lo ba baakasa bubi baakakala a nzalamweẽ. Kala ti we ka dzyi okala a nzalamweẽ a mfumu o, sa bubwe ya nde sa agwa we masyighi.

Mu kuulu, mfumu aakasalala Nzaami mu nkooro a bubwe bu we. Lo kala ti we si bubi, kala a nzalamweẽ, mu kuulu ka ku obwunu o mfumu ali a lipee, nde aakasalala Nzaami mu osyeme ya mu osuo nkehe a nde kundaa wu aakasalala bubi.
Me mu obo okihi litumu li bamfumu oli mupfunu, ka yini a mu nkooro obara nzalamweẽ a nkehe o, lo mu nkooro a embwuru ki ebwe si.
Me mu obo si be liikafiri mpagha. Mu kuulu esala ki okatolo mpagha, Nzaami áagwi bo kye.

Liikafiri kundaa nswe mbwuru ebyimi ki lili a be ya nde: Mpagha kundaa wu lifaana ofiri mpagha yi mawa-mawa, nzalamweẽ kundaa wu lifaana okala a be nzalamweẽ, budziri kundaa wu lifaana ogwa be budziri.
Ka likakala a ebyimi e mbwuru o, kala ka yini a okadzyi banganda be a be o. Mu kuulu munde wu aadzyi nganda, aakuhu Mikyene.

Mu kuulu, mikele mi: «Ka bvughu mbughu ya mukala bwunu we mulumu a nganda o, ka dzwa o, ka turu o, ka sughu mukolo o,» ya mikele myehene mi mike, bákuru mye mu ndagha yi: «Dzyi nganda-mbwuru ti bu budzyi we nyuru a we».
Dzyi ka liikasa bubi kundaa nganda-mbwuru o: Dzyi me okughu ku Mikyene.
Okala mukughu mu ogya o Kriste

Bu ligyighili osoolo mu nki matala lili: Ma ngu matala ma lifaana osighili be mu ensama, mu kuulu, lolo bu obvwughu obvulu obehene ya bihi-a-be. Obvwughu oko ka ofirisyili la ti mu matala mamo ma lísi bihi-a-be kana o.
Mpyibi ayi la, bwihi ayi ku bele a okya. Mu obo litswe litsili bigyighili bibi mpyibi, ya litswe lilaha bidzwana bii otsyeme.
Litswe likadzyara bwunu a bu ofaana, ti anga mu mwiĩ wu ebala, wene a byiri bibi bilyili ya bibi oŋma mala malagha, wene a esighi ya enkwunu, wene a mumbaŋana ya ebaa ki elagha.
Lo be lifaana olaha Mfumu Yiisu-Kriste ti anga eko ya linyaã ofirikagyighili mi ookadzyi musunu, mu okuhu dzyi li yo.
